preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 20,000.
The number of citizens m is between 1 and 10,000.
Each road connects two cities with 1 <= v, u <= n.
Each citizen lives in a city xi and works in a city yi with 1 <= xi, yi <= n.
Each citizen's home and work city are different.

postconditions.description: The total number of puppies needed k is between 1 and n.
The number of puppies given to citizens q is between 0 and the minimum of m and k.
The number of puppies given to guardians e is between 0 and the minimum of n - 1 and k.
The sum of the number of puppies given to citizens and guardians equals the total number of puppies needed k.

postconditions.expression: all(ai in range(1, m + 1)) for ai in [a1, a2, ..., aq]
postconditions.description: Each citizen index ai given a puppy is within the range of 1 to m.

postconditions.expression: all(bi in range(1, n) for bi in [b1, b2, ..., be]
postconditions.description: Each guardian index bi given a puppy is within the range of 1 to n - 1.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= v, u <= n for v, u in roads)
invariants.description: Each road connects two cities within the range of 1 to n.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= xi, yi <= n for xi, yi in citizens)
invariants.description: Each citizen lives and works in a city within the range of 1 to n.

invariants.expression: all(xi != yi for xi, yi in citizens)
invariants.description: Each citizen's home and work city are different.
